title: Docs wrong "--class" flag
author: jonaz
body:
Docs wrong after https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/pull/6282

forgot to update the --help info? It now differs from man pages? 
```
OPTIONS:
        --class <instance> | <instance>,<general>
            Defines window class/app_id on X11/Wayland [default: Alacritty]
```
vs man
```
--class <general> | <general>,<instance>
```
